name: github-sarif-policy
description: Upload GitHub SARIF security scan results after push.

post-push.description: Upload a SARIF security scan report for the resolved commit.

steps.run: REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner)} && REF=${GITHUB_REF:-$(git branch --show-current)} && gh api repos/$REPO/code-scanning/sarifs -F commit_sha={{version.CommitSha}} -F ref="$REF" -F tool_name='{{options.toolName}}' -F sarif=@{{options.sarifPath}}
